intro.text: A bridgeman of Bridge Four and one of its subsquad commanders.
A lieutenant of Bridge Four, which now serves as Dalinar Kholin's guard; with Moash, one of the crew's best fighters.
A member of Bridge Four who, after a long struggle to draw in Stormlight, has become a squire of the Windrunners.
A member of Bridge Four and a captainlord of the Windrunners.

items.text: Skar was a rocksplitter. He hoped to join the Blackcaps, Highprince Aladar's bodyguards, but they turned him away as too short, saying they might reconsider if he came with his own uniform, armour and weapons. With no money, he stole the gear from their quartermaster, hoping to look bold and resourceful. Instead they branded him a slave and sold him to Sadeas's army, which put him on the bridge crews, where he ended up in Bridge Four.

Skar was among the first bridgemen to join in eating Rock's stew, and he became one of the crew's subsquad commanders. He took his turn standing guard over Kaladin while Kaladin recovered from being strung up in a highstorm.
Skar took a wound to the leg during the battle on the Tower.

Kaladin made Skar a lieutenant, and he and Moash, the best fighters among the bridgemen, were assigned to guard Dalinar Kholin. When the crew received their new guard uniforms, Skar was the first to rip off the Cobalt Guard patch, insisting that they were Bridge Four.
At the battle of Narak, Skar and Drehy guarded Adolin. When Adolin nearly fell into a chasm, Skar caught hold of the steel skirt of his Shardplate and helped hold him up.

Two weeks after Narak, Skar was one of only three members of Bridge Four who still couldn't draw in Stormlight. He didn't want pity, but feared he would no longer be useful. In a test of Stormlight's effects he ran a mile through the Urithiru markets against a powered Drehy, then vented to Teft, who said there was nothing wrong with the support team. Skar refused to accept that.

Skar encouraged Lyn, a scout also struggling to draw in Stormlight, telling her how Kaladin had first drawn in Light on a bloody bridge run, pulling the arrows meant for Skar toward himself because he was thinking of saving his men, not of flying. As Lyn drew in Light, Skar resigned himself to teaching and asked Rock if he could help cook. Rock pointed out that he was glowing: he was a full squire.
Kaladin chose Skar for the mission to Kholinar. On the way, he showed a basic grasp of Lashings, helping Drehy and Kaladin keep the group in the air.
When fighting broke out in Kholinar, Skar was one of the better warriors in the group, moving between fighting beside Kaladin and protecting Shallan.

Skar and Drehy were left behind in Kholinar. They survived by covering their tattoos and scars with ash, and managed to protect Elhokar's son Gavinor, Vathah and the rest of Shallan's people, and a few other refugees. After the battle at Thaylen City, Kaladin found them hiding in a coastal cave in Alethkar.

Skar married Ristina, a scribe, with Bridge Four at the wedding. He flew on the Fourth Bridge's expedition to Hearthstone, fighting the Heavenly Ones with the other Windrunners. Before stepping down, Kaladin recommended him for a command role overseeing the Windrunners on missions.

Skar volunteered to escort Rock and his family home to the Horneater Peaks, leaving some weeks before Kaladin started working as a surgeon. He came back to Urithiru after the occupation ended and attended Teft's funeral with the rest of Bridge Four.

Skar turned down a promotion to company second, preferring to keep training would-be Windrunners in battlefield basics. One of his favourite drills is to have recruits set up camp, quietly take all their weapons while they're busy, then announce an attack.

appearance.text: Short and wiry, with sharp features and hair already greying at the temples though he is only in his early thirties. He is never without his spear.

personality.text: Skar took to Kaladin's training instinctively, as only Moash also did, and Kaladin thinks of him as a killer.
